name: MOKA
summary: MOKA overlays candidate keypoints and waypoint marks onto the observation and prompts a VLM to select grasp points, target points and intermediate waypoints, converting continuous motion synthesis into a multiple-choice visual question the VLM is actually good at. The selected marks parameterize simple motion primitives, and successful rollouts can be distilled back into a policy.
innovation: Visual mark-based prompting that sidesteps VLMs' weakness at emitting precise continuous coordinates.
Uses successful zero-shot rollouts as demonstrations for subsequent policy distillation.
matters: A widely copied trick for extracting spatial precision from models trained mostly on text.
limits: Restricted to tasks decomposable into a few waypoints and primitives.
lineage: Foundation-model grounding via visual prompting rather than generated code.
